summaryRequest.sourceRef: continuity report §6.1 — `config.thinkingConfig.includeThoughts: true` on generateContent. The field is a BOOLEAN, recorded here as its single enabling spelling because the schema's `values` is a string list; the Interactions API's `generation_config.thinking_summaries` is a different surface and is not claimed for this endpoint.

continuationDomain.sourceRef: continuity report §6.1, BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: a `thoughtSignature` is returned to the SAME model on its exact original part — "do not concatenate signed parts; do not move a signature to a different part; preserve every accumulated signature in a sequential function-call turn". Why the domain is NARROW: "A Gemini summary can be forwarded to another family. The `thoughtSignature` cannot." Signatures are bound to their exact part and model, so the domain is this model alone.

pricing.sourceRef: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing — Gemini 2.5 Pro paid tier, prompts <= 200k tokens: input $1.25, output $10.00, context-cache read $0.125 per 1M tokens. TIERED UPSTREAM: prompts > 200k are billed $2.50 / $15.00 / $0.25. `ModelPricing` has one rate per direction, so the STANDARD (<=200k) tier is recorded and cost is UNDER-reported for prompts above it — a disclosed schema gap (PROVENANCE.md), not a claim that the higher tier does not exist.
